messages:
Ravi: FYI noticed tenant 'greenrod' generated a long-tailed burst pattern that starved small tenants at the edge. thinking: combine a per-tenant soft-credit pool with probabilistic admission and a short "grace fallback" to a cheaper model before starting hard sheds. sketch below. thoughts?
Sophie: high level +1. need to avoid oscillation and false positives — how do we avoid punishing a tenant that suddenly has legitimate traffic? also ops playbook for rollback.
Ravi: agree, plan is: 1) short sliding window baseline to detect deviation, 2) allocate soft credits proportional to committed capacity, 3) when over baseline apply a probabilistic deny with backoff, and 4) route a configured percent to fallback model for a short grace period.
Diego: telemetry needs: per-tenant admit_rate, fallback_rate, credit_balance, 429_reason tag. also correlate against billing usage to surface surprises. request-id on credit mutations pls.
Marta: for allocator fairness we should compute shares from reserved commitments + recent usage (decayed). implement a lightweight deficit-round-robin at the gateway with per-tenant weight. if stateful, keep only small counters in proxy and authoritative state in credit-store.
Ravi: sketch config:

```json
{
  "admission": {
    "soft_credit": {"initial": "1000", "recharge_per_sec": "5", "max": "2000"},
    "baseline_window_seconds": "60",
    "probabilistic": {"base_admit": "0.98", "max_penalty": "0.5", "decay_seconds": "120"},
    "fallback": {"model": "micro-quant", "grace_percent": "25", "grace_seconds": "10"},
    "isolation_keys": ["tenant_id","region","route_prefix"],
    "emit_metrics": ["admit_rate","fallback_count","credit_balance","drop_reasons"]
  }
}
```

Sophie: love the config shape. operational concerns: canary the probabilistic layer on a small subset first. also add a "force-bypass" flag for billing/integration tests so infra teams can opt out.
Diego: testing plan: 1) run an adversarial generator that simulates many small keys and long-tail bursts, 2) measure inter-tenant tail latency and queue depth, 3) measure KV-cache miss pressure when routed to fallback models. I'll own the harness.
Marta: edge memory/state note: keep only compact counters in the gateway (ints + last-update), persist checkpoints to the regional credit-store every N seconds. on credit-store fail, degrade to permissive mode with throttled fallback to avoid full hard-shed.
Ravi: abuse detection hook: if tenant shows very fast credit consumption + new API prefixes pattern, escalate to abuse-service which can tag tenant for manual review and freeze credit top-ups. keep auto actions conservative.
Sophie: add audit log for all credit issuances and fallback decisions (who/why) and a retention policy. required for enterprise compliance.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: admission-prob-proxy v1 -> edge-zone-3 at 7632223500 :rocket:
Diego: add 429 payloads with small JSON: {"code":"quota_exceeded","reason":"probabilistic_reject","sample_token":"abcd"} so clients can retry/backoff properly.
Marta: next steps: Ravi to draft RFC follow-up with API boundaries (credit query/invalidate, fallback contract), SLO impact doc, and a rollback playbook. tag @eng-sre and @product for cost/SLA tradeoffs. I'll schedule a short sync.
Ravi: thanks — I'll open the RFC and attach test results once Diego's harness runs. :thumbsup:
